name: Augsburg

queries.query: Augsburg official cadastral map parcel Bayern BayernAtlas Flurstücke WMS WFS
queries.result: First-party discovery located the official Amt für Digitalisierung, Breitband und Vermessung Augsburg pages, the Bavarian LDBV BayernAtlas documentation, Geoportal Bayern service catalogue, and the official Bavaria ALKIS parcel-map service documentation. The open service is a raster WMS; vector parcel services are listed as authenticated/licensed.

queries.query: Augsburg amtliche Flurkarte Liegenschaftskataster Bayern Atlas Flurstücke
queries.result: Die amtlichen Seiten bestätigen das Amt für Digitalisierung, Breitband und Vermessung Augsburg als zuständige örtliche Stelle und ALKIS/Flurkarte als Katastergrundlage. Der kostenfreie ALKIS-Parzellarkarte-WMS liefert nur eine reduzierte Darstellung ohne Flurstücksnummern; der WFS ALKIS-vereinfacht und der Flurstückssuchdienst verlangen Freischaltung bzw. persönlichen Authentifizierungstoken.

officialSources.observation: Official Augsburg surveying-office page identifies the local office and explains that ALKIS contains parcel, building, actual-use and owner object areas. It directs public inspection and extracts to the competent office; owner information requires a justified interest.

Official City of Augsburg Geodatenamt page offers ordering of official cadastral extracts and digital city-map CAD extracts. It is a local service/procedure page, not an anonymous parcel-geometry endpoint.

Official LDBV OpenData catalogue documents the CC BY 4.0 ALKIS-Parzellarkarte WMS. It explicitly says the reduced map has parcel boundaries but no parcel numbers or boundary markers; it is image-only.
Official Geoportal catalogue lists INSPIRE-WMS/WFS BY Flurstücke/Grundstücke ALKIS, with authentication and paid/special terms, and identifies LDBV as provider.

registryBasis: The official Amt für Digitalisierung, Breitband und Vermessung Augsburg and City of Augsburg Geodatenamt pages evidence the local cadastral/map custodians and public extract procedures. This is custodian evidence, not evidence of an open anonymous parcel-vector adapter.

sourceCandidate.operator: Bayerische Vermessungsverwaltung / Landesamt für Digitalisierung, Breitband und Vermessung, with Amt für Digitalisierung, Breitband und Vermessung Augsburg as local office
sourceCandidate.crs: Public raster WMS advertises EPSG:4326; authenticated vector WFS documents EPSG:25832 default and supports EPSG:4326.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Bavaria-wide ALKIS parcel cartography and cadastral services, with Augsburg served by the local surveying office.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: A Bavaria-wide open raster WMS was verified over a small Augsburg extent, but no open parcel-vector response with stable native IDs was obtained.

remainingUncertainty: The official open WMS confirms visual parcel-boundary coverage but intentionally omits parcel numbers and cannot supply retained polygons. Vector WFS and coordinate lookup may be available under a paid/licensed or authenticated agreement; this attempt did not use credentials, request unsafe fields, or infer parcel absence from the authentication wall or exact-point result.
nextStep: Serial reviewer may independently assess whether an authorized, safe vector adapter is admissible; research packet itself remains held and is not source integration.
